Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: handbook v3.2 goes live next Monday. Main changes: parental leave clarification, moonlighting disclosure form, and updated expense thresholds.
Tess (Benefits): Parental leave section now includes phased return guidance + payroll coordination notes. We'll need payroll to confirm payout schedules.
Ibrahim (Payroll): Confirmed — payout schedules unchanged but we need HR to collect return-to-work dates to set phased pay correctly. Add a field 'expected_return_date' in the tracker.
Cam (Eng): For moonlighting disclosure, will this require manager approval or just an acknowledgement? Some folks prefer privacy.
Sam (People Ops): Disclosure form is confidential and goes to People Ops only. Managers are notified only if there's a conflict with project timelines or NDAs.
compliance-bot: REMINDER: handbook update requires mandatory acknowledgment from all active employees within 10 days of release. Non-compliance triggers weekly manager alerts.
Tess (Benefits): Action: I'll update the benefits FAQ doc and post highlights in #benefits. Sam, can People Ops publish a short changelog?
Sam (People Ops): Yes — changelog, redline, and one-paragraph summary will be posted. Also scheduling two 30-min open Q&A slots in week 1: one EMEA-friendly and one APAC-friendly.
Ibrahim (Payroll): I'll need the final text by Thursday EOD to update payroll notes and the parental leave payout flows.
Sam (People Ops): Noted. Finalization timeline: draft to Legal today, final by Thu EOD. We'll add the 'expected_return_date' column in the acknowledgement tracker.
Cam (Eng): Thanks. Please include a sample privacy blurb to share with my team.
Sam (People Ops): Will do. I'll drop sample comms in #people-ops-resources and ping when live.
